title: Special endurance coefficients enable the evaluation of running performance
claims: The authors analysed over 14,000 race times from competitive male runners and introduced the coefficient of special endurance (KsA).
They noticed that times for 1500 m and above were slightly different (e.g. about 10 seconds over 5000 m) between the VDOT tables and the VDOT online calculator.
They also noticed that the exponent in Riegel's original publication is 1.07732, while the respective online calculator uses an exponent of 1.06.
The paper reports that KsA values predict race times with less than one percent error, and that the reference ranges allow performance to be evaluated.
